name: Main no Utage
source:
"Kuroda Ryuuji", the main character, is a company employee.

He has feelings of hatred and jealousy toward a certain coworker at his company for having a higher position and having married Miyamai Chizuru, a woman he had his eyes on.

One day, Ryuuji finally hired a man to kidnap Chizuru's younger sister, Sonouchi Eri.

Ryuuji used this to threaten Chizuru.
The two sisters are confined.
Furthermore, in order to make them into the women he loves, their training has started.

[Translated from the [url=https://web.archive.org/web/20010124124700/http://www.blackpackage.co.jp/products/ma/index.html]official website[/url]]
translation:
主人公“黑田龙二”是一名公司员工。他对公司里一位职位更高、并且娶了他心仪的宫舞千鹤的同事怀有仇恨和嫉妒。

某天，龙二终于雇人绑架了千鹤的妹妹园内绘里。龙二以此来威胁千鹤。姐妹俩被囚禁了。为了将她们变成他所爱的模样，调教开始了。

[译自[url=https://web.archive.org/web/20010124124700/http://www.blackpackage.co.jp/products/ma/index.html]官方网站[/url]]
